verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a no-cost Free Edition workspace for exploring datasets and a self-serve free trial signup. Its notebooks can query sample data in Unity Catalog, so an analyst can run real queries without engaging sales. The docs, however, never state that signup needs no credit card, and they position Free Edition for learning and experimenting rather than evaluating your own data. Missing for 10: explicit no-credit-card signup documentation, documented Free Edition limits and quotas for loading your own data, independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup flow.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can evaluate with a free tier or trial — real queries on real data without a credit card or a sales call

citations.quote: Databricks Free Edition is a no-cost version of Databricks designed for students, educators, hobbyists, and anyone interested in learning or experimenting with data and AI.
Free Edition gives you an easy-to-use Databricks workspace where you can explore datasets, build and share projects, and work with AI and machine learning tools.
Start your journey with Databricks by signing up for a free trial account.
Use a Databricks notebook to query sample data stored in Unity Catalog and then visualize the query results in the notebook.
